correctness.rationale: On each nonnegative segment, the finite maximum of ball averages has piecewise linear derivative given by a constant-preserving selector. Every zero-sum cyclic gradient splits into nonnegative transports between positive and negative atoms, yielding an oriented-arc decomposition with total coefficient V(h)/2. Rotations and complements reduce all n=3,4,5 to five arc boxes; convexity of V on each box makes 104 exact rational endpoint evaluations exhaustive. verify_exact.py recomputes these box maxima and strict active-chamber witnesses at ratios 1, 5/4, 7/5, plus 3000 rational stress pairs. The general inequality follows from these analytic reductions, not the stress pairs; no assertions beyond the domain.

value.rationale: There is a motivated distinction between variation diminution of a nonlinear operator acting on one datum and stability of differences between two data sets. For the complete natural class of cycles of graph diameter at most two, the first dimension exhibiting pairwise amplification is four, despite strict individual variation contraction. Complete, attained constants quantify this mechanism and provide sharp benchmarks for discrete maximal-function perturbation stability; the small exact classification is a natural finite cutoff, not an arbitrarily chosen slice.
